ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 makes the cancellation fee chargeable ONLY IF all four conditions hold, and two of them can be proved from nothing but the gps_trace: limb (b), that the trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event, and limb (c), that the trace shows a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup. The trip's trace, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING: payload null, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING, 'no driver-device or platform GPS export exists for the waiting window'). Under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact carries no fact, and its absence is itself citable. Limbs (b) and (c) of POL-NS-01 therefore fail, and where any of (a) to (d) fails the fee is not chargeable under that clause. The SGD 6.00 must be refunded to the rider in full.

POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have arrived at the pickup point only where the gps_trace contains at least 3 consecutive position fixes, each accurate to 25 m or better, falling within the arrival radius - 150 m for a TRANSPORT_HUB such as the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay recorded on this trip. The record contains no qualifying in-radius fix at all, because it contains no trace at all: EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and can carry neither presence nor absence. The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is not satisfied, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The driver's own counterparty statement on file concedes the point against him: 'I was at the bay for the full waiting period, but the GPS export is unavailable.' The system message 'Your driver has arrived' (21:10:21) and the driver's chat line 'I am at the private-hire bay' (21:10:40) are a platform prompt and a party assertion respectively; POL-NS-01 does not permit either to substitute for the gps_trace it requires, and the artifact it requires is absent (EV-GPS-09109: MISSING, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). A driver who cannot produce the trace cannot establish the arrival and dwell on which the charge depends.

Even on the platform's own timestamps the margin is thin, and it is the wrong clock. The 'arrived' event is 21:10:20 and cancellation is 21:15:40, a span of about 320 seconds against the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, with trip_record.wait_time_min of 5.3 minutes recording the same figure - roughly 20 seconds of headroom. But POL-NS-01 limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and expressly not from the 'arrived' event. No qualifying fix exists (EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the only dwell measure the clause recognises cannot be computed, and the raw 320 second span is no proof that the statutory 300 seconds was ever held in the bay.

The traffic-advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is also MISSING - weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, 'no traffic advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window' - so there is no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT in the record that could explain a failure to hold position at the bay, and no advisory is available to permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed under POL-NS-06(i). Its absence is citable and it cuts against chargeability: nothing in this bundle relieves the driver of the in-geofence dwell that POL-NS-01 requires.

The rider-exoneration route in POL-NS-04 is not available on this record, and I do not rely on it: the driver posted a reply 15 seconds after the rider's locating message (rider at 21:11:30, driver at 21:11:45), so limb (b) of that clause is not met. But POL-NS-04's unavailability is not a reason to charge the fee - it only removes one shortcut to a refund and leaves the dispute to POL-NS-01, whose GPS limbs fail anyway. The rider's message 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' remains an unrebutted contemporaneous statement by a rider who says she was at the bay, and nothing in the bundle places her anywhere else.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on clean evidence: the trip record for TRP-09109 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-09T21:10:20+08:00, and that artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: no boarding event and no started_at are recorded, and the driver terminated the trip at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — 320 seconds after the arrived marker — so the termination falls at or after the moment the 300-second minimum dwell for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup elapsed. This is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE case, which would put the trip under POL-NS-03.

The recorded wait of 5.3 minutes (arrived 21:10:20, cancelled 21:15:40) exceeds the fee_schedule minimum_dwell_sec of 300 seconds for TRANSPORT_HUB, so no waiting-period shortfall arises and POL-NS-06 cannot be used to refund the fee.

The rider's exoneration clause does not apply. POL-NS-04 limb (b) requires that the driver did not reply in the chat within 120 seconds of the rider's locating message; the rider wrote 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' at 21:11:30 and the driver answered 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45 — 15 seconds later — having already posted 'I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40. Limb (b) fails, so POL-NS-04 is unavailable regardless of the content of the reply, and any residual location dispute falls to be decided elsewhere.

The driver's GPS export is MISSING — EV-GPS-09109 carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at BLOCKING severity and weight_multiplier 0.0. Under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact holds no payload, can carry no fact, and its absence alone is citable; it is evidence of neither the driver's presence nor his absence, exactly as an over-tolerance fix is neither under POL-NS-02. POL-NS-02's proximity test is therefore not affirmatively failed, and the rider's assertion that the car was not at the bay rests on her own perception rather than on any artifact.

POL-NS-05 cannot be turned against the driver either: the false-arrival test needs the trace to place him more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above, at the arrived timestamp. EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), so neither limb can be established and the arrival marker cannot be declared false on this record.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup and waiting window: EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING, weight 0.0). POL-NS-06 requires a present and populated advisory before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, so limb (i) is unavailable and nothing in the record displaces the charge or extends the waiting window in the rider's favour.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on the citable trailing-window fields: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and the ratio to driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is about 0.008, far below 0.08. Compensation is therefore not withheld, and if POL-NS-01 is satisfied the driver is owed 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee — SGD 4.80.

The present state is a charge of SGD 6.00 with payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule (the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X tier fee of SGD 4.00). The dispute is rider-filed, so on POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION ruling leaves that state exactly as it stands and does not reverse the charge — the correct disposition where the rider has proven nothing by admissible evidence.

In the alternative, if the Judge concludes the arrival test simply cannot be run because the only artifact that could carry the arrival and dwell facts (EV-GPS-09109, MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) is absent, then no admissible evidence carries the deciding fact, the confidence cap under POL-GEN-02 falls below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-NS-09(a) requires escalation with the SGD 6.00 fee held rather than refunded. Even on that least favourable reading the record supports holding this fee, not returning it to the rider.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 6.00 no-show fee on trip TRP-09109 is placed ON HOLD — neither collected nor refunded — and the case goes to a human reviewer. On this record I can neither confirm the charge nor order a refund.

WHY THE FEE CANNOT BE CONFIRMED OR DEFEATED. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable ONLY IF four conditions hold, and two of them are GPS conditions: (b) the trace places the driver inside the 150 m Transport-Hub arrival radius for the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay at or before the 21:10:20 'arrived' marker, and (c) the trace shows a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and expressly NOT from the 'arrived' marker. The GPS trace EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING — issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING, weight 0.0, 'no driver-device or platform GPS export exists for the waiting window'. Under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact carries no fact and only its absence is citable, and under POL-NS-08(b) the window holds zero fixes (fewer than six). Limbs (b) and (c) therefore cannot be run at all. A test that never ran decides nothing in either direction: it neither supports the SGD 6.00 charge (which needs limbs (b) and (c) to hold) nor a refund (which needs them to fail). Limbs (a) and (d) are satisfied on the trip record (arrived marker 21:10:20; terminated 21:15:40 by the driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding, no started_at) and the platform's recorded wait of 5.3 minutes is consistent with the 300-second minimum — but limb (c) does not accept the arrived marker as the dwell measure.

THE RIDER'S CLAIMS. Her central claim — that the missing trace makes limbs (b) and (c) 'fail' and yields a full refund of the SGD 6.00 — is rejected as to direction: absence is not a failed test, and POL-NS-08 caps a ruling resting on impaired deciding evidence at PARTIAL_REFUND and sends it to POL-NS-09, so the outcome is escalation, not a refund. Her POL-NS-02 argument ('no qualifying in-radius fix') also fails: that clause's 'never arrived' result presupposes a trace that ran and found nothing, and here there is no trace. Her reliance on the counterparty statement ('I was at the bay for the full waiting period, but the GPS export is unavailable'), the system prompt 'Your driver has arrived' (21:10:21) and the chat lines ('I am at the private-hire bay', 21:10:40; 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car', 21:11:30; 'I am here beside the sign', 21:11:45) is answered: these are contemporaneous and I have read them, but they are accounts offered where the GPS test admitted no reading at all, so they neither decide limbs (b)/(c) nor lift the confidence cap. The counterparty statement carries no weight and so enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of that cap. Her point that the thin 320-second span (21:10:20 to 21:15:40) is on the wrong clock for limb (c) is correct, and it cuts both ways. Her profile claim is accepted: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged, and prior_no_show_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

THE DRIVER'S CLAIMS. His main claim — that the absent trace cannot be turned against him, so the SGD 6.00 stands (NO_ACTION) — is rejected: the fee is chargeable only if limbs (b) and (c) hold, they are undecided, and an undecided limb cannot support leaving a SGD 6.00 charge in place. His alternative — that the arrival test cannot be run, that the only evidence for the deciding fact is therefore impaired, and that escalation with the fee held is required — is the one I adopt. His remaining points are accepted: the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below 4; 1/120 ≈ 0.008, below 0.08), so no compensation is withheld and the SGD 4.80 figure is not payable; POL-NS-04 is unavailable (the driver replied 15 seconds after the rider's locating message, so limb (b) fails); POL-NS-05(ii) cannot fire without a trace; and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is MISSING (BLOCKING, weight 0.0), so POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to sum separate in-geofence intervals — its absence neither defeats nor supports the charge on its own.

OTHER CHECKS. The chat log is intact (four messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count = 4, no sequence gap), so no POL-NS-08(c) defect. The fare line reconciles — the greater of the SGD 6.00 Transport-Hub zone fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee is SGD 6.00, and payment_status is PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — so no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

CONFIDENCE AND TRIGGERS. The only artifact that could carry the deciding fact — whether the driver arrived and held the bay — is EV-GPS-09109 at weight 0.0, and no independent admissible artifact carries it; confidence is therefore capped at 0.0, below the 0.70 floor (POL-NS-09(a)), and the same impairment makes it the sole impaired evidence for the deciding fact (POL-NS-09(e)). No referral is issued, and the SGD 6.00 is held meanwhile.

FOR THE REVIEWER: please establish from device or platform telemetry whether the driver was inside the 150 m radius of the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay pin at or before 21:10:20 and held continuously for at least 300 seconds before cancelling at 21:15:40. If arrival and dwell are confirmed, the SGD 6.00 fee stands; if not, it is refunded in full.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
